title: Implement dependency-scoped cancellation and orchestrator notify/relay mechanisms
task_summary: Implement dependency-scoped transitive cancellation in WorkflowEngine, notify standing orchestrators exactly once per task state transition, serialize turn communication per orchestrator, relay worker questions back to orchestrators, and persist raw activity model data.

previous_step_review.checked: src/core/plan_executor.py, src/api/execute.py, src/core/coordinator.py, src/clients/github.py, src/core/account_pool.py, dryrun/test_full_workflow.py, dryrun/test_gaps.py

files_changed.change: Added orchestrator_session_id string field to AgentTask model.
Added orchestrator_session_id to agent_tasks table schema and created idx_agent_tasks_orchestrator index.
Added orchestrator_session_id to SQLite table schema and implemented database schema migrations and index creation inside _migrate_tables.
Added save_task_orchestrator and get_task_orchestrator methods to ContextStore.
Re-implemented run() to calculate transitive dependents and perform dependency-scoped transitive cancellation rather than workflow-wide cancellation.
Created notify_orchestrator and relay_worker_feedback with lock-based turn serialization per standing orchestrator session ID.
Updated _poll_session to call notify_orchestrator on state transitions and trigger relay_worker_feedback when awaiting user feedback.

Updated _poll_until_done to call notify_orchestrator and relay_worker_feedback on state transitions if task_id is supplied, and fixed _store_activity to serialize full Pydantic Activity models to raw_data.
